{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011Cg7xn8cuoUDfBRy8sTbk3","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01MewtD95Kxohp4KXXS919pC","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > cahn-hilliard/cahn_hilliard.cpp <<'EOF'\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <sched.h>\n#include <pthread.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// 3D index calculation\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Point-wise arithmetic.  The expression structure is kept identical to the\n// original scalar code so that results are bit-for-bit reproducible\n// irrespective of thread count or tiling.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// 7-point Laplacian from already-gathered neighbour values\ninline double laplacian7(const double cc, const double cxp, const double cxn,\n                         const double cyp, const double cyn, const double czp, const double czn,\n                         const double dx, const double dy, const double dz) noexcept {\n    const double cxx = (cxp + cxn - 2.0 * cc) / (dx * dx);\n    const double cyy = (cyp + cyn - 2.0 * cc) / (dy * dy);\n    const double czz = (czp + czn - 2.0 * cc) / (dz * dz);\n    return cxx + cyy + czz;\n}\n\n// Compute Laplacian with clamped boundary conditions (generic, any point)\ninline double computeLaplacian(const double* __restrict c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                               const double dx, const double dy, const double dz,\n                               const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z) noexcept {\n    const size_t xp = (x < nx - 1) ? x + 1 : x;\n    const size_t yp = (y < ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;\n    const size_t zp = (z < nz - 1) ? z + 1 : z;\n    const size_t xn = (x > 0) ? x - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t zn = (z > 0) ? z - 1 : 0;\n\n    return laplacian7(c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)],\n                      c[idx3(xp, y, z, nx, ny)], c[idx3(xn, y, z, nx, ny)],\n                      c[idx3(x, yp, z, nx, ny)], c[idx3(x, yn, z, nx, ny)],\n                      c[idx3(x, y, zp, nx, ny)], c[idx3(x, y, zn, nx, ny)],\n                      dx, dy, dz);\n}\n\ninline double chemicalPotentialPoint(const double cv, const double lap,\n                                     const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB) noexcept {\n    return 4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * e_BB - 2.0 * cv * e_AB)\n           + 3.0 * cv + cv * cv * cv\n           - gamma * lap;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Row kernels\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Chemical potential for one full row (y, z) of the concentration field c,\n// written to out[0..nx).\ninline void chemicalPotentialRow(const double* __restrict c, double* __restrict out,\n                                 const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                                 const size_t y, const size_t z,\n                                 const double dx, const double dy, const double dz,\n                                 const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB) noexcept {\n    const size_t sxy = nx * ny;\n    const size_t zp = (z < nz - 1) ? z + 1 : z;\n    const size_t zn = (z > 0) ? z - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t yp = (y < ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;\n    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;\n\n    const double* __restrict row   = c + z * sxy + y * nx;\n    const double* __restrict rowYp = c + z * sxy + yp * nx;\n    const double* __restrict rowYn = c + z * sxy + yn * nx;\n    const double* __restrict rowZp = c + zp * sxy + y * nx;\n    const double* __restrict rowZn = c + zn * sxy + y * nx;\n\n    // x = 0 boundary (clamped)\n    out[0] = chemicalPotentialPoint(row[0], computeLaplacian(c, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, 0, y, z),\n                                    gamma, e_AA, e_BB, e_AB);\n    // interior: no clamping, vectorizable\n    for (size_t x = 1; x + 1 < nx; ++x) {\n        const double cv = row[x];\n        const double lap = laplacian7(cv, row[x + 1], row[x - 1], rowYp[x], rowYn[x], rowZp[x], rowZn[x],\n                                      dx, dy, dz);\n        out[x] = chemicalPotentialPoint(cv, lap, gamma, e_AA, e_BB, e_AB);\n    }\n    if (nx > 1) {\n        out[nx - 1] = chemicalPotentialPoint(row[nx - 1],\n                                             computeLaplacian(c, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, nx - 1, y, z),\n                                             gamma, e_AA, e_BB, e_AB);\n    }\n}\n\n// Cahn-Hilliard update for one row given the (already clamped) neighbouring\n// rows of the chemical potential.\ninline void cahnHilliardRow(double* __restrict out, const double* __restrict old,\n                            const double* __restrict m,\n                            const double* __restrict mYp, const double* __restrict mYn,\n                            const double* __restrict mZp, const double* __restrict mZn,\n                            const size_t nx, const double D, const double dt,\n                            const double dx, const double dy, const double dz) noexcept {\n    {\n        const size_t xp = (nx > 1) ? 1 : 0;\n        out[0] = old[0] + dt * D * laplacian7(m[0], m[xp], m[0], mYp[0], mYn[0], mZp[0], mZn[0], dx, dy, dz);\n    }\n    for (size_t x = 1; x + 1 < nx; ++x) {\n        out[x] = old[x] + dt * D *\n                 laplacian7(m[x], m[x + 1], m[x - 1], mYp[x], mYn[x], mZp[x], mZn[x], dx, dy, dz);\n    }\n    if (nx > 1) {\n        const size_t x = nx - 1;\n        out[x] = old[x] + dt * D *\n                 laplacian7(m[x], m[x], m[x - 1], mYp[x], mYn[x], mZp[x], mZn[x], dx, dy, dz);\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Tiling of the (z, y) plane set into blocks that are distributed over threads.\n// Each tile is processed by one thread as a single fused sweep: the chemical\n// potential is computed (with a one-row/one-plane halo) into a small rolling\n// buffer and immediately consumed by the concentration update, so each time\n// step streams the concentration field through memory only once.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstruct Tiling {\n    size_t ytile = 1;   // rows per tile\n    size_t ztile = 1;   // planes per tile\n    size_t nyt = 1;     // number of tiles in y\n    size_t nzs = 1;     // number of tiles in z\n};\n\nTiling chooseTiling(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz, const size_t nthreads) {\n    // Keep the rolling mu buffer (3 planes of (ytile + 2) rows) small enough to\n    // stay in the private/shared cache: aim for <= 1 MiB.\n    const size_t bufLimitBytes = size_t(1) << 20;\n    size_t ytileMax = bufLimitBytes / (3 * nx * sizeof(double));\n    ytileMax = (ytileMax > 2) ? ytileMax - 2 : 1;\n    ytileMax = std::min(ytileMax, ny);\n    ytileMax = std::max<size_t>(ytileMax, 1);\n    const size_t nytMin = (ny + ytileMax - 1) / ytileMax;\n\n    Tiling best;\n    double bestCost = -1.0;\n    const size_t nytCap = std::min<size_t>(ny, 8192);\n    const size_t nzsCap = std::min<size_t>(nz, 8192);\n    for (size_t nyt = nytMin; nyt <= nytCap; ++nyt) {\n        const size_t yt = (ny + nyt - 1) / nyt;\n        if ((ny + yt - 1) / yt != nyt) continue;   // skip equivalent decompositions\n        for (size_t nzs = 1; nzs <= nzsCap; ++nzs) {\n            const size_t zt = (nz + nzs - 1) / nzs;\n            if ((nz + zt - 1) / zt != nzs) continue;\n            const size_t ntiles = nyt * nzs;\n            const size_t perThread = (ntiles + nthreads - 1) / nthreads;\n            // Work per tile ~ halo-extended mu computation + update\n            const double cost = double(perThread) *\n                                (double(yt + 2) * double(zt + 2) + double(yt) * double(zt));\n            if (bestCost < 0.0 || cost < bestCost) {\n                bestCost = cost;\n                best.ytile = yt;\n                best.ztile = zt;\n                best.nyt = nyt;\n                best.nzs = nzs;\n            }\n            if (ntiles >= nthreads * 8) break;   // more tiles only add halo work\n        }\n    }\n    return best;\n}\n\n// One fused time step over the whole grid.\n// Must be called from inside an OpenMP parallel region (orphaned worksharing\n// loop); `ring` is a thread-private buffer of 3 * (ytile + 2) * nx doubles.\nvoid cahnHilliardStep(double* __restrict cnew, const double* __restrict cold,\n                      double* __restrict ring, const Tiling& tl,\n                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                      const double D, const double dt, const double dx, const double dy, const double dz,\n                      const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB) {\n    const size_t sxy = nx * ny;\n    const size_t planeStride = (tl.ytile + 2) * nx;\n\n#pragma omp for collapse(2) schedule(static)\n    for (size_t zs = 0; zs < tl.nzs; ++zs) {\n        for (size_t yt = 0; yt < tl.nyt; ++yt) {\n            const size_t z0 = zs * tl.ztile;\n            const size_t z1 = std::min(z0 + tl.ztile, nz);\n            const size_t y0 = yt * tl.ytile;\n            const size_t y1 = std::min(y0 + tl.ytile, ny);\n            if (z0 >= z1 || y0 >= y1) continue;\n\n            const size_t ybeg = (y0 > 0) ? y0 - 1 : 0;\n            const size_t yend = std::min(y1 + 1, ny);\n\n            auto muPlane = [&](const size_t zz) {\n                double* __restrict slot = ring + (zz % 3) * planeStride;\n                for (size_t y = ybeg; y < yend; ++y) {\n                    chemicalPotentialRow(cold, slot + (y - ybeg) * nx, nx, ny, nz, y, zz,\n                                         dx, dy, dz, gamma, e_AA, e_BB, e_AB);\n                }\n            };\n\n            if (z0 > 0) muPlane(z0 - 1);\n            muPlane(z0);\n\n            for (size_t z = z0; z < z1; ++z) {\n                if (z + 1 < nz) muPlane(z + 1);\n                const size_t zp = (z < nz - 1) ? z + 1 : z;\n                const size_t zn = (z > 0) ? z - 1 : 0;\n                const double* __restrict pz  = ring + (z % 3) * planeStride;\n                const double* __restrict pzp = ring + (zp % 3) * planeStride;\n                const double* __restrict pzn = ring + (zn % 3) * planeStride;\n\n                for (size_t y = y0; y < y1; ++y) {\n                    const size_t yp = (y < ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;\n                    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;\n                    const size_t base = z * sxy + y * nx;\n                    cahnHilliardRow(cnew + base, cold + base,\n                                    pz + (y - ybeg) * nx,\n                                    pz + (yp - ybeg) * nx, pz + (yn - ybeg) * nx,\n                                    pzp + (y - ybeg) * nx, pzn + (y - ybeg) * nx,\n                                    nx, D, dt, dx, dy, dz);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Initialize concentration field.  Uses the same tile -> thread mapping as the\n// time stepping so that pages are first-touched by the thread that works on them.\nvoid initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                             const Tiling& tl) {\n    const size_t vol = nx * ny * nz;\n    double* __restrict cp = c.data();\n\n#pragma omp parallel for collapse(2) schedule(static)\n    for (size_t zs = 0; The benchmark in `cahn-hilliard/` is now OpenMP-parallel, builds warning-free, and produces bit-identical results to the original at every size and thread count I tested.\n\n**What changed** (only `cahn_hilliard.cpp` and `CMakeLists.txt`, executable name unchanged):\n\n- **Fused, tiled time step.** The chemical-potential and concentration-update sweeps are now one pass. Each thread owns a (z-slab × y-block) tile, computes mu with a one-row/one-plane halo into a small private rolling buffer, and updates its tile immediately. The field streams through memory once per step instead of roughly four times.\n- **Single parallel region** spans the whole time loop, with one implicit barrier per step. Buffers are swapped via thread-local pointers.\n- **Vectorizable rows.** Interior x-points run without clamping branches; the two x-boundary cells use the original clamped path.\n- **Exact reciprocal fast path.** When 1/(d·d) is exactly representable, which includes the default spacing of 1.0, the Laplacian multiplies instead of divides. This is bit-identical to division and removed the compute bottleneck. Non-power-of-two spacings fall back to division.\n- **NUMA-correct allocation.** Simulation buffers are raw allocations that are first-touched by the owning thread under the same tile mapping. The old vector construction zero-filled everything from the main thread, which put all data on one socket.\n- **Thread placement.** By default the program uses one thread per physical core and pins each thread. Any user-set `OMP_PROC_BIND`, `OMP_PLACES`, `GOMP_CPU_AFFINITY`, or `OMP_NUM_THREADS` is respected and overrides this.\n- **Parallel init, validation, and output copy.** Init uses the tile mapping for first touch. Validation uses OpenMP reductions.\n- **CMake** now requires OpenMP and links it unconditionally.\n\n**Correctness verification.** Result hashes, sums, min/max, and samples from the `-r` output match the original program exactly for 128³, 256³, 512³, an odd-shaped grid, degenerate sizes (1³, 2³, 3³, 1×7×5, 9×1×1, 5×5×1, 2×300×300), 0 and 1 iterations, and thread counts of 1, 3, 7, 13, 100, 256, and 300.\n\n**Performance** on this 2-socket, 128-core EPYC 7763 (default 128 threads):\n\n| Grid | Original | Now | Speedup |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 256³, 20 steps | 167 MCUPS | ~14,000-15,000 MCUPS | ~85x |\n| 512³, 10 steps | 128 MCUPS | ~10,900 MCUPS | ~85x |\n| 64³, 200 steps | n/a | 11 ms total | barrier-bound |\n\nOne note: at 512³ the kernel moves about 280 GB/s, which is near the practical DRAM limit of this machine, so further gains there would need temporal blocking across time steps rather than more threads."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3282,"cache_read_input_tokens":83385,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3282},"output_tokens":731,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"06671cc0-5176-4aa7-8eba-bfeeee2bde84","uuid":"d418b17e-5f35-42c7-b8c3-8324125ec2d2","timestamp":"2026-10-17T14:34:46.513Z","request_id":"req_011Cg7yWjBUTSTirJ5SpXNGB"}
